answer.rationale: The incumbent will not reopen price, so renewal or negotiation cannot meet the mandated 18% reduction. The low-cost vendor's quote meets the target, and prior experience indicates fast onboarding and accurate invoicing. However, the line has only 6% volume headroom and the contract ends in 14 days, so delivery-continuity risk remains material; verify the archived low-cost-vendor record before committing and require transition/delivery safeguards in execution.
